---
title: "Comparative Enrichment Across Modules - `r params$traitname`"
subtitle: "`r if (exists('params') && !is.null(params$traitname)) paste0('Trait: ', params$traitname) else if (exists('params') && !is.null(params$trait)) paste0('Trait: ', params$trait) else if (exists('params') && !is.null(params$project_name)) paste0('Project: ', params$project_name) else ''`"
date: "`r format(Sys.time(), '%d %B %Y')`"
author: "PhyloPhere pipeline"
output:
  html_document:
    theme: flatly
    syntax_highlighting: tango
    toc: true
    toc_float:
      collapsed: false
      smooth_scroll: false
    code_folding: hide
    df_print: paged
    fig_width: 10
    fig_height: 6
    self_contained: true
    mathjax: null                       # no math in this report
    md_extensions: "-tex_math_dollars"  # gene-set names contain '$' (e.g. V$HNF4_01) - never parse as TeX math
params:
  fcs_dir:    "cmp_fcs"       # dir of per-module <module>_fcs_all.tsv
  fcs_le_dir: "cmp_fcs_le"    # dir of per-module <module>_leading_edge.tsv
  fdr_thr:    0.15
  pperm_thr:  0.025
  domino_module_thr: 0.05  # DOMINO's own module-significance cutoff (domino.nf's domino_module_thr)
  top_n:      250
  traitname:  "trait"
  ami_availability_file: NULL
  ami_module_desc_file:       NULL  # AMI's ami_networks/module_descriptions_all_lists.tsv (optional)
  ami_term_membership_file:   NULL  # AMI's ami_networks/term_threshold_membership.tsv (optional, recurrence table)
  # SCORING's own gene-level table (nominal/BH activity flags + FADE/RER
  # significance), used by 12.FCS_general_report.Rmd,
  # reused here for the Interesting Genes/Positions tables.
  fcs_stats_file: NULL
  gene_scores_file: NULL
  gene_metadata_file: NULL
  # Position-level CAAS scores + FADE-site/VEP annotations for the Interesting
  # Positions table.
  position_scores_file:  NULL
  vep_primateai_file:    NULL
  vep_cosmic_file:       NULL
  vep_ensembl_file:      NULL
  fade_sites_top_file:    NULL
  fade_sites_bottom_file: NULL
  # POSENRICH's per-position characterization layers (PFAM domain/clan, UCR core/flank
  # region + per-position variability, FUBAR selection call): position_characterization.tsv,
  # flattened for a direct Gene/Position join here. Optional; without it those columns are omitted.
  position_characterization_file: NULL
  seed:               "1998"
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
# Fallback tool classifier from a gene-list filename, used when an AMI export
# predates the explicit `tool` column. Defined here (not next to its main use
# in ami_term_membership_tabs below) because cross_angle_gene_hits, an earlier
# and unconditionally-evaluated chunk, also needs it as a fallback.
.ami_tool_classifier <- function(gl) {
  dplyr::case_when(
    grepl("^rer_",  gl, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "RER",
    grepl("^fade_", gl, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "FADE",
    TRUE                                    ~ "CAAS"
  )
}
```

```{r load, include=FALSE}
`%||%` <- function(a, b) if (!is.null(a)) a else b
source("src/fcs_selection.R")
# Persist the actual presentation thresholds for standalone GUI regeneration.
dir.create("compare_results", showWarnings=FALSE)
jsonlite::write_json(params[c("fdr_thr","pperm_thr","domino_module_thr","top_n","seed")],
  "compare_results/report_settings.json",auto_unbox=TRUE,pretty=TRUE)
REQ <- c("ranking", "database", "pathway", "stat", "p.adj", "p.perm", "q.perm", "sig_perm", "cluster_id")

# Per-module FCS results: cmp_fcs/<module>_fcs_all.tsv (caas/rer).
mod_files <- list.files(params$fcs_dir, pattern = "_fcs_all\\.tsv$", full.names = TRUE)
fcs_by_mod <- list()
for (f in mod_files) {
  mod <- sub("_fcs_all\\.tsv$", "", basename(f))
  d <- tryCatch(readr::read_tsv(f, show_col_types = FALSE), error = function(e) NULL)
  if (!is.null(d) && nrow(d) > 0 && all(REQ %in% names(d))) {
    if(mod=="caas" && (!"gene_stat" %in% names(d) || anyNA(d$gene_stat) || any(d$gene_stat!="max"))) {
      warning("CAAS FCS unavailable: max provenance missing/retired; regenerate calibrated results")
      next
    }
    d <- fcs_selection(d,params$fdr_thr,params$pperm_thr)
    fcs_by_mod[[mod]] <- dplyr::mutate(d, module = mod)
  }
}
fcs_all_mod <- if (length(fcs_by_mod)) dplyr::bind_rows(fcs_by_mod) else tibble()
modules_present <- names(fcs_by_mod)
has_multi <- length(fcs_by_mod) >= 1

# Direction facet (Global/top/bottom), derived once here since every directional section
# below groups by it. CAAS has the three rankings; RER has only its signed global one. CAAS's
# "global" ranking is its OWN direction here, kept fully separate from top/bottom: a "global" row
# can never share a (module, direction, database, pathway) group key with a "top" or "bottom" row.
if (has_multi) {
  fcs_dir_mod <- fcs_all_mod %>%
    mutate(effect_direction=direction, direction = dplyr::case_when(
      tolower(ranking) == "top"    ~ "top",
      tolower(ranking) == "bottom" ~ "bottom",
      tolower(ranking) == "global" ~ "global",
      TRUE                         ~ NA_character_
    )) %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(direction))
} else {
  fcs_dir_mod <- fcs_all_mod
}

# Per-module leading-edge tables (cmp_fcs_le/<module>_leading_edge.tsv) feed
# the Interesting Genes/Positions criteria below: each module's own
# directional nominal/BH activity flags + cross-module corroboration flags
# (FADE/RER, and PrimateAI-3D/COSMIC). Activity flags reflect CAAS's own evidence in every module's
# leading edge (per-module FCS
# reports are annotated with CAAS's fcs_stats.tsv as their overlay) - that's
# intentional, not a bug: it's the shared reference axis every module's
# leading edge is cross-checked against.
le_files <- list.files(params$fcs_le_dir, pattern = "_leading_edge\\.tsv$", full.names = TRUE)
le_by_mod <- list()
for (f in le_files) {
  mod <- sub("_leading_edge\\.tsv$", "", basename(f))
  d <- tryCatch(readr::read_tsv(f, show_col_types = FALSE), error = function(e) NULL)
  if (!is.null(d) && all(c("ranking","database","pathway","gene") %in% names(d)))
    le_by_mod[[mod]] <- dplyr::mutate(d, module = mod)
}
le <- if (length(le_by_mod)) dplyr::bind_rows(le_by_mod) else tibble()
has_le <- nrow(le) > 0

# ── Cross-angle inputs: AMI (network modules) ──
# AMI is not gene-set-ranked the way CAAS/RER FCS is, so it does not fold into
# fcs_all_mod/le above; it gets its own section below and feeds the Interesting
# Genes/Interesting Positions tables via the genes it involves.
.file_ok <- function(p) !is.null(p) && !is.na(p) && nchar(p) > 0 && file.exists(p) && file.info(p)$size > 0

ami_availability <- if(.file_ok(params$ami_availability_file))
  readr::read_tsv(params$ami_availability_file,show_col_types=FALSE) else tibble()
if(!all(c("tool","gene_list","view","modules_verified","n_modules","descriptions_available","available","status") %in% names(ami_availability)))
  ami_availability <- tibble()
# All three current exports form one bundle. Do not interpret historical tables
# or a partial bundle as verified descriptions, including header-only exports.
ami_bundle_ok <- nrow(ami_availability)>0 && .file_ok(params$ami_module_desc_file) && .file_ok(params$ami_term_membership_file)
has_ami <- ami_bundle_ok
ami_df  <- if (has_ami) readr::read_tsv(params$ami_module_desc_file, show_col_types = FALSE) else NULL
if(!is.null(ami_df) && (!"provenance_verified" %in% names(ami_df) || any(!evidence_truth(ami_df$provenance_verified)))) {
  warning("AMI descriptions lack verified module/list provenance; regenerate AMI")
  ami_df <- NULL; has_ami <- FALSE
}
ami_disp <- NULL

# AMI term membership recurrence table (term_threshold_membership.tsv from
# 13.AMI_analysis.Rmd's render_tool_section_nested()) - imported directly
# rather than re-derived, so the table shown here matches the AMI report exactly.
has_ami_term_membership <- ami_bundle_ok
ami_term_membership_df  <- if (has_ami_term_membership) readr::read_tsv(params$ami_term_membership_file, show_col_types = FALSE) else NULL
if(!is.null(ami_term_membership_df) && (!"provenance_verified" %in% names(ami_term_membership_df) || any(!evidence_truth(ami_term_membership_df$provenance_verified)))) {
  warning("AMI term membership lacks verified provenance; regenerate AMI")
  ami_term_membership_df <- NULL; has_ami_term_membership <- FALSE
}

if(has_ami_term_membership && !all(c("term","is_representative") %in% names(ami_term_membership_df))) {
  warning("AMI term membership has no term blocks; regenerate AMI")
  ami_term_membership_df <- NULL; has_ami_term_membership <- FALSE
}

# Availability covers the shared Global/Top/Bottom comparison views. Signed RER
# lists also occur in the certified exports and retain their own sections.
if(has_ami) {
  if(!all(c("tool","gene_list","direction","all_genes","domino_p_adj","description") %in% names(ami_df))) {
    ami_df <- NULL; has_ami <- FALSE
  } else {
    has_ami <- nrow(ami_df)>0
  }
}
if(has_ami_term_membership) {
  if(!all(c("tool","gene_list","direction","term") %in% names(ami_term_membership_df))) {
    ami_term_membership_df <- NULL; has_ami_term_membership <- FALSE
  } else {
    has_ami_term_membership <- nrow(ami_term_membership_df)>0
  }
}

# Per-module leading-edge composition tables (fcs_leading_edge_composition.tsv
# from 12.FCS_general_report.Rmd) - imported directly so the table shown here
# matches the FCS reports exactly.
le_comp_files <- list.files(params$fcs_le_dir, pattern = "_leading_edge_composition\\.tsv$", full.names = TRUE)
le_comp_by_mod <- list()
for (f in le_comp_files) {
  mod <- sub("_leading_edge_composition\\.tsv$", "", basename(f))
  d <- tryCatch(readr::read_tsv(f, show_col_types = FALSE), error = function(e) NULL)
  if (!is.null(d) && nrow(d) > 0) le_comp_by_mod[[mod]] <- dplyr::mutate(d, module = mod)
}
le_comp_all_mod <- if (length(le_comp_by_mod)) dplyr::bind_rows(le_comp_by_mod) else tibble()
has_le_comp <- nrow(le_comp_all_mod) > 0

# ── Gene/position-level inputs for the Interesting Genes/Positions tables ──
# Optional files (fcs_stats, position_scores, VEP, FADE sites) used as they are,
# not re-derived.
has_fcs_stats_cmp <- .file_ok(params$fcs_stats_file)
fcs_stats_cmp_df  <- if (has_fcs_stats_cmp) readr::read_tsv(params$fcs_stats_file, show_col_types = FALSE) else NULL

has_position_scores_cmp <- .file_ok(params$position_scores_file)
position_scores_cmp_df  <- if (has_position_scores_cmp) readr::read_tsv(params$position_scores_file, show_col_types = FALSE) else NULL
if (!is.null(position_scores_cmp_df) && "Position" %in% names(position_scores_cmp_df)) {
  position_scores_cmp_df$Position <- suppressWarnings(as.integer(position_scores_cmp_df$Position))
}
if (!is.null(position_scores_cmp_df) && "Gene" %in% names(position_scores_cmp_df)) {
  position_scores_cmp_df$Gene <- as.character(position_scores_cmp_df$Gene)
}
if (!is.null(position_scores_cmp_df) && "gene" %in% names(position_scores_cmp_df)) {
  position_scores_cmp_df$gene <- as.character(position_scores_cmp_df$gene)
}
if (!is.null(position_scores_cmp_df) && "side" %in% names(position_scores_cmp_df)) {
  position_scores_cmp_df$side <- as.character(position_scores_cmp_df$side)
}

has_vep_primateai_cmp <- .file_ok(params$vep_primateai_file)
vep_primateai_cmp_df  <- if (has_vep_primateai_cmp) readr::read_tsv(params$vep_primateai_file, show_col_types = FALSE) else NULL

has_vep_cosmic_cmp <- .file_ok(params$vep_cosmic_file)
vep_cosmic_cmp_df  <- if (has_vep_cosmic_cmp) readr::read_tsv(params$vep_cosmic_file, show_col_types = FALSE) else NULL

has_vep_ensembl_cmp <- .file_ok(params$vep_ensembl_file)
if (has_vep_ensembl_cmp) {
  vep_ensembl_cmp_df <- readr::read_tsv(params$vep_ensembl_file, name_repair = "minimal", show_col_types = FALSE)
  .dup_g <- which(names(vep_ensembl_cmp_df) == "Gene")
  if (length(.dup_g) > 1L) names(vep_ensembl_cmp_df)[.dup_g[-1]] <- "Ensembl_Gene"
  if ("Position" %in% names(vep_ensembl_cmp_df)) vep_ensembl_cmp_df$Position <- suppressWarnings(as.integer(vep_ensembl_cmp_df$Position))
  if ("side"     %in% names(vep_ensembl_cmp_df)) vep_ensembl_cmp_df$side     <- as.character(vep_ensembl_cmp_df$side)
} else {
  vep_ensembl_cmp_df <- NULL
}

# <vep_collapse>
# Reduces the per-transcript rows of the Ensembl VEP table to ONE consequence per group (by default Gene, Position,
# side). The transcript is chosen by rule: the MANE Select row, else the canonical row (the MANE_SELECT / CANONICAL
# columns, or the same keys in Extra, when vep ran with --mane / --canonical), else, when the group has no flagged row,
# the most severe consequence over all its rows. Ties within a rule go to the most severe consequence (VEP severity
# order of the Ensembl consequence table) and then to the lowest Feature ID. Returned columns: the `by` columns,
# Feature, Consequence (all terms of the chosen row), top_consequence (its most severe term), IMPACT (when present),
# transcript_rule and missense_only (TRUE when the chosen row carries no term other than missense_variant).
.vep_so_order <- c(
  "transcript_ablation", "splice_acceptor_variant", "splice_donor_variant", "stop_gained", "frameshift_variant",
  "stop_lost", "start_lost", "transcript_amplification", "feature_elongation", "feature_truncation",
  "inframe_insertion", "inframe_deletion", "missense_variant", "protein_altering_variant",
  "splice_donor_5th_base_variant", "splice_region_variant", "splice_donor_region_variant",
  "splice_polypyrimidine_tract_variant", "incomplete_terminal_codon_variant", "start_retained_variant",
  "stop_retained_variant", "synonymous_variant", "coding_sequence_variant", "mature_miRNA_variant",
  "5_prime_UTR_variant", "3_prime_UTR_variant", "non_coding_transcript_exon_variant", "intron_variant",
  "NMD_transcript_variant", "non_coding_transcript_variant", "coding_transcript_variant", "upstream_gene_variant",
  "downstream_gene_variant", "TFBS_ablation", "TFBS_amplification", "TF_binding_site_variant",
  "regulatory_region_ablation", "regulatory_region_amplification", "regulatory_region_variant",
  "intergenic_variant", "sequence_variant"
)
.vep_term_rank <- function(x) {
  r <- match(x, .vep_so_order)
  r[is.na(r)] <- length(.vep_so_order) + 1L   # a term outside the table ranks last
  r
}
collapse_vep_consequence <- function(df, by = c("Gene", "Position", "side")) {
  df <- as.data.frame(df, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  extra <- if ("Extra" %in% names(df)) as.character(df$Extra) else rep("", nrow(df))
  extra[is.na(extra)] <- ""
  terms <- lapply(strsplit(as.character(df$Consequence), ",", fixed = TRUE),
                  function(t) { t <- trimws(t); t[!is.na(t) & nzchar(t) & t != "-"] })
  keep <- lengths(terms) > 0L
  df <- df[keep, , drop = FALSE]; extra <- extra[keep]; terms <- terms[keep]
  out_cols <- c(by, "Feature", "Consequence", "top_consequence", if ("IMPACT" %in% names(df)) "IMPACT",
                "transcript_rule", "missense_only")
  if (nrow(df) == 0L) {
    out <- df[0, intersect(c(by, "Feature", "IMPACT"), names(df)), drop = FALSE]
    out$Consequence <- character(0); out$top_consequence <- character(0)
    out$transcript_rule <- character(0); out$missense_only <- logical(0)
    return(out[, intersect(out_cols, names(out)), drop = FALSE])
  }
  if (!"Feature" %in% names(df)) df$Feature <- NA_character_
  # MANE Select and canonical flags: columns of their own in the tab output of current vep releases, key=value
  # pairs of the Extra column in older ones.
  .col <- function(nm) if (nm %in% names(df)) as.character(df[[nm]]) else rep("", nrow(df))
  .set <- function(x) !is.na(x) & nzchar(x) & x != "-"
  is_mane <- .set(.col("MANE_SELECT")) | .col("MANE") %in% "MANE_Select" | grepl("MANE_SELECT=|MANE=MANE_Select", extra)
  is_canonical <- .col("CANONICAL") %in% "YES" | grepl("CANONICAL=YES", extra)
  tier <- ifelse(is_mane, 1L, ifelse(is_canonical, 2L, 3L))
  severity <- vapply(terms, function(t) min(.vep_term_rank(t)), numeric(1))
  grp <- do.call(paste, c(unname(as.list(df[by])), sep = "\r"))
  ord <- order(grp, tier, severity, as.character(df$Feature))
  first <- ord[!duplicated(grp[ord])]   # best tier, then most severe, per group
  out <- df[first, intersect(c(by, "Feature", "IMPACT"), names(df)), drop = FALSE]
  out$Consequence      <- vapply(terms[first], paste, character(1), collapse = ",")
  out$top_consequence  <- vapply(terms[first], function(t) t[which.min(.vep_term_rank(t))], character(1))
  out$transcript_rule  <- c("MANE Select", "canonical", "most severe")[tier[first]]
  out$missense_only    <- vapply(terms[first], function(t) all(t == "missense_variant"), logical(1))
  rownames(out) <- NULL
  out[, out_cols, drop = FALSE]
}
# </vep_collapse>

has_fade_sites_top_cmp    <- .file_ok(params$fade_sites_top_file)
has_fade_sites_bottom_cmp <- .file_ok(params$fade_sites_bottom_file)
read_fade_sites_cmp <- function(path) {
 d <- readr::read_csv(path,show_col_types=FALSE,col_types=readr::cols(.default=readr::col_character()))
 if(!all(c("gene","position","max_bf","target_aa") %in% names(d))) stop("Invalid FADE selected-sites schema: ",path)
 d <- d %>% transmute(gene=sub("\\.[0-9]+$","",trimws(gene)),
   Position=suppressWarnings(as.integer(position)),max_bf=suppressWarnings(as.numeric(max_bf)),target_aa=as.character(target_aa))
 if(anyNA(d$Position) || any(d$Position<0) || anyNA(d$max_bf)) stop("Invalid FADE site position/BF: ",path)
 d
}
fade_sites_top_cmp_df <- if(has_fade_sites_top_cmp) read_fade_sites_cmp(params$fade_sites_top_file) else NULL
fade_sites_bottom_cmp_df <- if(has_fade_sites_bottom_cmp) read_fade_sites_cmp(params$fade_sites_bottom_file) else NULL

# POSENRICH's per-position PFAM domain/clan, UCR core/flank region + per-position
# variability, and FUBAR selection call (position_characterization.tsv) - characterization-only, like COSMIC/PAI3D
# below, so joined straight in without any selection or significance gating.
has_position_char_cmp <- .file_ok(params$position_characterization_file)
position_char_cmp_df  <- if (has_position_char_cmp) {
  # A header-only file (no gene tested any position, plausible on a small
  # universe) gives readr nothing to infer types from, so every column -
  # Position included - comes back character; force it back to integer so
  # the later left_join by c("gene", "Position") against position_scores_cmp_df's
  # numeric Position doesn't fail on incompatible types (same fix already
  # applied to fade_sites_top/bottom_cmp_df above for the same reason).
  readr::read_tsv(params$position_characterization_file, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(Position = suppressWarnings(as.integer(Position)))
} else NULL
if(!is.null(position_char_cmp_df) && "fubar_selection" %in% names(position_char_cmp_df))
  position_char_cmp_df$fubar_selection <- dplyr::recode(as.character(position_char_cmp_df$fubar_selection),negative="purifying",pervasive="purifying")


# Per-gene attribute table: nominal/BH activity flags (from the canonical gene
# evidence, same derivation as 12.FCS_general_report.Rmd) + the gene-level
# flag_* columns fcs_stats.tsv already carries (gate/FADE/RER,
# direction-aware).
.nominal_cmp <- .05; .fdr_cmp <- .05
has_gene_scores_cmp <- .file_ok(params$gene_scores_file)
gene_attr_df <- if(has_gene_scores_cmp) {
  gs <- readr::read_tsv(params$gene_scores_file,show_col_types=FALSE)
  if(anyDuplicated(gs$Gene)) stop("Duplicate canonical gene keys")
  stamp <- params$gene_metadata_file
  if(!.file_ok(stamp)) stamp <- file.path(dirname(params$gene_scores_file),"gene_evidence_metadata.json")
  if(!.file_ok(stamp) || !identical(jsonlite::read_json(stamp)$gene_stat,"max")) stop("Canonical gene evidence requires max metadata")
  .saved <- jsonlite::read_json(stamp,simplifyVector=TRUE)
  .nominal_cmp <- as.numeric(.saved$nominal_threshold); .fdr_cmp <- as.numeric(.saved$fdr_threshold)
  gs$gene <- as.character(gs$Gene)
  for(sf in c("","_top","_bottom")) {
    gs[[paste0("flag_fade",sf)]] <- if(sf=="") evidence_column(gs,"fade_significant_top",NA) | evidence_column(gs,"fade_significant_bottom",NA) else evidence_column(gs,paste0("fade_significant",sf),NA)
  }
  gs$rer_p.emp <- evidence_column(gs,"rer_min_pval")
  gs$rer_p.adj <- evidence_column(gs,"rer_perm_padj")
  gs$flag_rer_acc <- evidence_column(gs,"rer_significant",NA) & evidence_column(gs,"rer_rho")>0
  gs$flag_rer_decc <- evidence_column(gs,"rer_significant",NA) & evidence_column(gs,"rer_rho")<0
  gs
} else if (has_fcs_stats_cmp) {
  pf <- fcs_evidence_flags(fcs_stats_cmp_df)
  for(nm in grep("^caas_p|^rer_p",names(fcs_stats_cmp_df),value=TRUE)) pf[[nm]] <- fcs_stats_cmp_df[[nm]]
  flag_cols_cmp <- grep("^flag_",names(fcs_stats_cmp_df),value=TRUE)
  dplyr::left_join(pf,fcs_stats_cmp_df[,c("gene",flag_cols_cmp)],by="gene")
} else tibble::tibble(gene=character())
has_gene_candidates <- nrow(gene_attr_df)>0 || has_le || has_ami

```

```{r cross_angle_gene_hits, include=FALSE}
# ── Cross-angle gene-level hit sets ───────────────────────────────────────
# Computed once here so the per-module significance section, the AMI module
# description section, and the Interesting Genes/Positions tables below all
# read the same per-gene FCS corroboration, one shared definition,
# not three drifting copies.
#
# Each method retains its own significance criterion. Gene BH, FCS selection C,
# formal FCS BH, and DOMINO module Bonferroni are separate levels.
# AMI Global is an actual global list, not a pool of side-specific module analyses.
# RER Positive/Negative are signs, never CAAS Top/Bottom.

# FCS selection and formal significance are separate. Keep every C>0 term and every
# formal q.perm hit (including any edge case where the input lacks C), with both labels.
# fcs_leading_edge.tsv (`le`) is NOT itself restricted to significant terms
# (12.FCS_general_report.Rmd's leading-edge export has every term), inner_join against
# fcs_sig_terms is what restricts fcs_genes to genes belonging to a term each module itself
# calls significant.
if (has_multi && !"is_representative" %in% names(fcs_dir_mod)) fcs_dir_mod$is_representative <- NA
fcs_sig_terms <- if (has_multi) {
  fcs_dir_mod %>%
    dplyr::filter((selected_C %in% TRUE) | (sig_RER %in% TRUE)) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(description = dplyr::coalesce(description, pathway)) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(fcs_selected_C = selected_C %in% TRUE,
                  fcs_formal_sig = sig_RER %in% TRUE) %>%
    dplyr::distinct(module, direction, database, pathway, description, cluster_id, q.perm,
                    fcs_selected_C, fcs_formal_sig, is_representative)
} else {
  tibble::tibble(module = character(), direction = character(), database = character(),
                 pathway = character(), description = character(), cluster_id = character(),
                 q.perm = numeric(), fcs_selected_C = logical(), fcs_formal_sig = logical(),
                 is_representative = logical())
}

fcs_genes <- if (has_le && has_multi) {
  le %>%
    dplyr::select(module,ranking,database,pathway,gene) %>% distinct() %>%
    dplyr::mutate(direction = dplyr::case_when(
      ranking == "top"    ~ "top",
      ranking == "bottom" ~ "bottom",
      ranking == "global" ~ "global",
      TRUE                ~ NA_character_
    )) %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(direction)) %>%
    dplyr::inner_join(fcs_sig_terms, by = c("module", "direction", "database", "pathway")) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(direction = tools::toTitleCase(direction)) %>%
    dplyr::distinct(gene, direction) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(fcs_hit = TRUE)
} else {
  tibble::tibble(gene = character(), direction = character(), fcs_hit = logical())
}

# AMI angle: DOMINO's own module-significance cutoff (domino_module_thr,
# domino.nf's own default 0.05) gates which described modules count --
# "described" alone (not Too small/No enrichment) was never a significance
# claim, just "STRING could summarise it". Expands each significant module's
# FULL membership into one row per gene: `all_genes` (every member gene,
# uncapped, describe_clusters() in 13.AMI_analysis.Rmd) when present, else
# the older capped `genes` column (top-8 representatives) for
# module_descriptions_all_lists.tsv files written before all_genes existed.
# direction is only ever "Top"/"Bottom" here (DOMINO never runs on an
# undirected gene list, so there's no "Global" value to filter for, see
# this chunk's opening comment).

ami_disp <- if (has_ami && !is.null(ami_df) && nrow(ami_df) > 0) {
  d <- ami_df %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      .tool = if ("tool" %in% names(.)) as.character(tool) else .ami_tool_classifier(gene_list),
      direction = if ("direction" %in% names(.)) dplyr::case_when(
        direction %in% c("Acc", "accelerating", "Accelerating", "Positive") ~ "Positive",
        direction %in% c("Decc", "decelerating", "Decelerating", "Negative") ~ "Negative",
        TRUE ~ as.character(direction)
      ) else NA_character_
    )
  if ("description" %in% names(d)) {
    d <- d %>% dplyr::filter(!description %in% c("Too small", "No enrichment", "Enrichment unavailable"))
  }
  if ("domino_p_adj" %in% names(d)) {
    d <- d %>% dplyr::filter(!is.na(domino_p_adj), domino_p_adj <= (params$domino_module_thr %||% 0.05))
  }
  if (nrow(d) > 0 && "description" %in% names(d)) {
    if(has_ami_term_membership && all(c("tool","gene_list","cluster","term","is_representative") %in% names(ami_term_membership_df))) {
      tm <- ami_term_membership_df %>% distinct(tool,gene_list,cluster,term,is_representative)
      d <- d %>% left_join(tm,by=c("tool","gene_list","cluster"))
    } else {
      d <- d %>% mutate(term=strsplit(description,"\\s*/\\s*")) %>% tidyr::unnest(term)
      d$is_representative <- TRUE
    }
  } else if (nrow(d) > 0) {
    d$term <- character(nrow(d))
  } else {
    d$term <- character(0)
  }
  d
} else NULL

ami_genes <- if (has_ami && !is.null(ami_df) && nrow(ami_df) > 0) {
  .ami_gene_col <- if ("all_genes" %in% names(ami_df)) "all_genes" else if ("genes" %in% names(ami_df)) "genes" else NULL
  if (is.null(.ami_gene_col)) {
    tibble::tibble(gene = character(), direction = character(), ami_hit = logical())
  } else {
    d <- ami_df %>%
      dplyr::mutate(
        .tool = if ("tool" %in% names(.)) as.character(tool) else .ami_tool_classifier(gene_list),
        direction = if ("direction" %in% names(.)) dplyr::case_when(
          direction %in% c("Acc", "accelerating", "Accelerating", "Positive") ~ "Positive",
          direction %in% c("Decc", "decelerating", "Decelerating", "Negative") ~ "Negative",
          TRUE ~ as.character(direction)
        ) else NA_character_
      )
    if ("description" %in% names(d)) {
      d <- d %>% dplyr::filter(!description %in% c("Too small", "No enrichment", "Enrichment unavailable"))
    }
    if ("direction" %in% names(d)) {
      d <- d %>% dplyr::filter(direction %in% c("Global","Top", "Bottom","Positive","Negative"))
    }
    if ("domino_p_adj" %in% names(d)) {
      d <- d %>% dplyr::filter(!is.na(domino_p_adj), domino_p_adj <= (params$domino_module_thr %||% 0.05))
    }
    if (nrow(d) > 0) {
      d %>%
        dplyr::mutate(gene = strsplit(.data[[.ami_gene_col]], ",\\s*")) %>%
        tidyr::unnest(gene) %>%
        dplyr::mutate(gene = trimws(gene)) %>%
        dplyr::distinct(gene, direction) %>%
        dplyr::mutate(ami_hit = TRUE)
    } else {
      tibble::tibble(gene = character(), direction = character(), ami_hit = logical())
    }
  }
} else {
  tibble::tibble(gene = character(), direction = character(), ami_hit = logical())
}

```

# Overview

```{r overview, echo=FALSE}
mod_rows <- if (has_multi) sapply(fcs_by_mod, nrow) else integer(0)
tibble::tibble(
  Source = paste0("FCS module: ", names(mod_rows)),
  Rows   = unname(mod_rows)
) %>% kbl_html()
```

This report compares enrichment **across CAAS and RERconverge** (the two modules
with well-behaved FCS rankings and real permulation nulls) for `r params$traitname`.
FADE does not run its own FCS ranking: its statistic is a max over many sites,
which does not support a reliable genome-wide gene-set enrichment test on its
own. It remains available as **cross-module corroboration**, surfaced as flag
columns (`%fade_*`/`%rer_*`) in the imported leading-edge composition tables
below and as evidence annotations in the Interesting Genes/Positions tables further
down. A gene set is "significant" when `q.perm` (BH on the permulation p of the Wilcoxon-AUC
test, per ranking and database) is below `r params$fdr_thr` - see
[12.FCS_general_report.Rmd](12.FCS_general_report.Rmd)'s Methods section for the test, the
separate Redlich rule and the grouping of overlapping sets (`cluster_id`) that
this report's tables use. CAAS has the global, top and bottom rankings; RER has its signed
global ranking only.

DOMINO active-module (AMI) results are not gene-set-ranked the same way as FCS, so they
get their own section below.

```{r comparison-reduction, results='asis'}
report_term_reduction_note()
report_emit(report_table(report_db_dictionary()))
```

# Per-module FCS selection {.tabset .tabset-fade}

Leading-edge composition from each module's own FCS report
([12.FCS_general_report.Rmd](12.FCS_general_report.Rmd)), imported directly so the
tables shown here match the per-module reports exactly. For each set selected by C>0 (separate from formal BH significance), the **percentage of its leading-edge genes** carrying each attribute:
nominal/BH activity flags and cross-module support. Rows follow the order of the source
FCS report (C descending, checks descending, then q.perm/p.perm), already baked
into the imported table, with the term block of each set (`Group`, `Rep` for its
representative). Global/Top/Bottom retain their own rankings; RER separates positive and negative effects. All rows are available through pagination.

`r if (!has_le_comp && !has_multi) "> **No module FCS results available - skipping.**"`

```{r permod_prep, eval=has_multi}
dir.create("compare_results", showWarnings = FALSE)
```

```{r permod_le_comp_tabs, eval=has_le_comp, results='asis'}
# Direction mapping for the ranking column in the imported tables.
.le_comp_dir_map <- c(top = "Top", bottom = "Bottom", global = "Global")

le_comp_all_mod <- le_comp_all_mod %>%
  dplyr::mutate(effect_direction=if("direction"%in%names(.))direction else NA_character_,direction = dplyr::coalesce(.le_comp_dir_map[tolower(ranking)], "Global"))

for (dr in c("Global", "Top", "Bottom")) {
  cat(sprintf("\n## %s {.tabset}\n\n", dr))

  mods_to_show <- union(modules_present, unique(le_comp_all_mod$module))
  for (m in mods_to_show) {
    cat(sprintf("\n### %s {.tabset}\n\n", toupper(m)))
    d <- le_comp_all_mod %>%
      dplyr::filter(module == m, direction == dr) %>%
      dplyr::select(-module, -direction) %>% dplyr::rename(direction=effect_direction)
    if (nrow(d) == 0) {
      cat(sprintf("_No leading-edge composition for %s (%s)._\n\n", toupper(m), dr))
    } else {
      report_term_views(d,level=4L,signed=m=="rer")
    }
  }
}
```

```{r permod_tabs_fallback, eval=has_multi && !has_le_comp, results='asis'}
# Fallback: list the significant sets of each module when the imported leading-edge
# composition tables are not available. Same order as 12.FCS_general_report.Rmd:
# C descending, checks descending, q.perm, p.perm; separate from formal BH significance.
thr <- params$fdr_thr
for (dr in c("global", "top", "bottom")) {
  cat(sprintf("\n## %s {.tabset}\n\n", tools::toTitleCase(dr)))
  for (m in modules_present) {
    cat(sprintf("\n### %s {.tabset}\n\n", toupper(m)))
    d <- fcs_dir_mod %>%
      filter(module == m, direction == dr, selected_C %in% TRUE) %>%
      fcs_selection_order() %>%
      mutate(Description = stringr::str_trunc(dplyr::coalesce(description, pathway), 60),
             AUC = stat + 0.5,
             Group = cluster_id, Rep = ifelse(dplyr::coalesce(is_representative, FALSE), "X", "")) %>%
      select(database, pathway, Description, C, checks, sig_RER, R05, R10, R15, direction=effect_direction, AUC, p.adj, q.perm, Group, Rep)
    if (nrow(d) == 0) {
      cat(sprintf("_No gene set is selected by C>0 in %s (%s); BH cutoff %.2g remains separate._\n\n", toupper(m), dr, thr))
    } else {
      report_term_views(d,level=4L,signed=m=="rer")
    }
  }
}
```

# AMI module descriptions {.tabset .tabset-fade}

`r if (!has_ami && !has_ami_term_membership) "> **No verified AMI descriptions available; consult method/view availability below.**"`

DOMINO active modules ([informe AMI actual](`r paste0('../html_reports/13.AMI_analysis_',params$traitname,'.html')`)) aren't gene-set-ranked
like CAAS/RER FCS, so they don't fold into the FCS tables above. The recurrence table
below shows each described term and which gene lists it was recovered under - imported
directly from the AMI report so the table shown here matches that report exactly.

```{r ami-availability, results='asis'}
if(nrow(ami_availability)>0) {
  report_emit(report_table(ami_availability))
} else cat("_La disponibilidad AMI por método/vista no está documentada; no se interpreta como ausencia de módulos._\n\n")
```

```{r ami_term_membership_tabs, eval=has_ami_term_membership, results='asis'}
# Imported term membership recurrence table from AMI report.
# .ami_tool_classifier is defined in the setup chunk above (needed earlier by
# cross_angle_gene_hits too).
.ami_tm_direction <- function(gl) {
  dplyr::case_when(
    grepl("global|significant$", gl, ignore.case = TRUE) & !grepl("top|bottom|accelerating|decelerating", gl, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "Global",
    grepl("accelerating", gl, ignore.case=TRUE) ~ "Positive",
    grepl("top",gl,ignore.case=TRUE) ~ "Top",
    grepl("decelerating", gl, ignore.case=TRUE) ~ "Negative",
    grepl("bottom",gl,ignore.case=TRUE) ~ "Bottom",
    TRUE ~ "Global"
  )
}

ami_tm <- ami_term_membership_df
ami_tm <- ami_tm %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    .tool      = if ("tool" %in% names(.)) as.character(tool) else .ami_tool_classifier(gene_list),
    .direction = dplyr::case_when(
      "direction" %in% names(.) & direction %in% c("Acc", "accelerating", "Accelerating", "Positive") ~ "Positive",
      "direction" %in% names(.) & direction %in% c("Decc", "decelerating", "Decelerating", "Negative") ~ "Negative",
      "direction" %in% names(.) & direction %in% c("Top", "Bottom", "Global", "Positive", "Negative") ~ as.character(direction),
      TRUE ~ .ami_tm_direction(gene_list)
    )
  )

for (tl in c("CAAS", "RER", "FADE")) {
  cat(sprintf("\n## %s {.tabset}\n\n", tl))
  tl_df <- ami_tm %>% dplyr::filter(.tool == tl)
  if (nrow(tl_df) == 0) {
    cat(sprintf("_No verified described terms for %s; see availability above._\n\n", tl))
    next
  }

  for (dr in if(tl=="RER")c("Global","Positive","Negative") else c("Global","Top","Bottom")) {
    cat(sprintf("\n### %s {.tabset}\n\n", dr))
    sub <- tl_df %>% dplyr::filter(.direction == dr)
    if (nrow(sub) == 0) {
      cat(sprintf("_No described terms for %s (%s)._\n\n", tl, dr))
      next
    }

    for(view in c("Representatives","All terms")) {
    cat(sprintf("\n#### %s\n\n",view))
    src <- sub
    if(view=="Representatives" && "is_representative" %in% names(src)) src <- src[src$is_representative %in% TRUE,,drop=FALSE]
    disp <- src %>%
      dplyr::distinct(term, gene_list) %>%
      dplyr::group_by(term) %>%
      dplyr::summarise(`N lists` = dplyr::n(),
                        `Gene lists` = paste(sort(unique(gene_list)), collapse = ", "),
                        .groups = "drop") %>%
      dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(`N lists`), term) %>%
      dplyr::rename(Term = term)
    report_emit(report_table(disp))
    }
  }
}
```

```{r ami_desc_fallback_prep, eval=has_ami && !has_ami_term_membership}
# Fallback: re-derive when the imported term membership file isn't available.
.build_ami_rollup <- function(df) {
  df %>%
    dplyr::group_by(term) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      `N modules`    = dplyr::n(),
      `Gene lists`   = paste(sort(unique(gene_list)), collapse = ", "),
      `DOMINO p.adj` = { v <- if ("domino_p_adj" %in% names(.data)) domino_p_adj[!is.na(domino_p_adj)] else numeric(0); if (length(v)) min(v) else NA_real_ },
      Genes          = suppressWarnings(max(n_genes, na.rm = TRUE)),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::rename(Term = term) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(`DOMINO p.adj`)
}
```

```{r ami_desc_fallback_tabs, eval=has_ami && !has_ami_term_membership, results='asis'}

  if (!exists("ami_disp") || is.null(ami_disp) || nrow(ami_disp) == 0) {
```

# AMI term recurrence across methods {.tabset}

Representatives keep the best term of each block of its module (blocks of terms with overlapping module genes, as in the AMI report); All terms keeps every term below the description cutoff. Terms are matched by exact description text. Only verified, evaluable lists enter the denominator. RER Global is shown as a reference in CAAS Top/Bottom views.

```{r comparative-ami-recurrence, results='asis'}
if(has_ami_term_membership && nrow(ami_availability)) {
 reg <- list()
 av <- ami_availability %>% distinct(tool,gene_list,.keep_all=TRUE)
 for(tool in unique(tolower(av$tool))) {
  z <- av[tolower(av$tool)==tool,,drop=FALSE]
  reg[[tool]] <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(z)),function(i)list(list_name=z$gene_list[i],
    modules_verified=evidence_truth(z$modules_verified[i]),n_modules=as.integer(z$n_modules[i]),
    descriptions_available=evidence_truth(z$descriptions_available[i]),available=evidence_truth(z$available[i]),skip_message=z$status[i]))
 }
 for(v in c("Global","Top","Bottom")) {
  cat(sprintf("\n## %s {.tabset}\n\n",v))
  for(mode in c("Representatives","All terms")) {
   cat(sprintf("\n### %s\n\n",mode))
   tm <- ami_term_membership_df
   if(mode=="Representatives") tm <- tm[tm$is_representative %in% TRUE,,drop=FALSE]
   rec <- ami_recurrence(tm,reg,v)
   report_emit(report_table(rec$summary))
   write_tsv(rec$summary,file.path("compare_results",paste0("ami_recurrence_",tolower(v),"_",if(mode=="Representatives")"representatives" else "all_terms",".tsv")))
  }
 }
} else cat("_Verified AMI recurrence inputs are unavailable._\n\n")
```

# Términos FCS y genes contribuyentes {.tabset}

Se incluyen todos los términos con BH de permulación significativo y todos los seleccionados
por C>0, con etiquetas separadas. Representantes es la vista inicial; All terms conserva los no representantes. Los genes mostrados
son contribuyentes del leading edge. La pertenencia completa a una vía es una anotación distinta. Las direcciones de
los efectos RER conservan su signo propio. Si falta el leading edge de un módulo,
los términos se conservan y el número de contribuyentes queda desconocido.

```{r complete-fcs-contributors, results='asis'}
if(has_multi) {
  contributor_source <- if(has_le) le else tibble(module=character(),ranking=character(),database=character(),pathway=character(),gene=character())
  contributors <- contributor_source %>% select(module,ranking,database,pathway,gene) %>% distinct() %>%
    mutate(direction=tolower(ranking)) %>% inner_join(fcs_sig_terms,by=c("module","direction","database","pathway"))
  dir.create("compare_results",showWarnings=FALSE)
  write_tsv(contributors,"compare_results/fcs_contributors_all_terms.tsv")
  terms <- contributors %>% group_by(module,ranking,database,pathway,description,q.perm,
    fcs_formal_sig,fcs_selected_C,cluster_id,is_representative) %>%
    summarise(n_contributors=n_distinct(gene),contributors=paste(sort(unique(gene)),collapse=", "),.groups="drop")
  # A significant term with no retained leading edge must still remain visible.
  terms <- fcs_sig_terms %>% mutate(ranking=direction) %>%
    left_join(terms %>% select(module,ranking,database,pathway,n_contributors,contributors),
              by=c("module","ranking","database","pathway")) %>%
    mutate(leading_edge_available=module %in% names(le_by_mod),
      n_contributors=ifelse(leading_edge_available,coalesce(n_contributors,0L),NA_integer_)) %>%
    arrange(module,ranking,q.perm,database,pathway)
  write_tsv(terms,"compare_results/fcs_terms_complete.tsv")
  for(mod in unique(terms$module)) {
    cat(sprintf("\n## %s {.tabset}\n\n",toupper(mod)))
    for(rk in unique(terms$ranking[terms$module==mod])) {
      cat(sprintf("\n### %s {.tabset}\n\n",tools::toTitleCase(rk)))
      td <- terms %>% filter(module==mod,ranking==rk)
      td$direction <- ifelse(grepl("negative",td$cluster_id),"negative",ifelse(grepl("positive",td$cluster_id),"positive",NA_character_))
      report_term_views(td,level=4L,signed=mod=="rer")
    }
  }
} else cat("_No hay tablas FCS/leading edge actuales disponibles._\n\n")
```

# FCS term recurrence across methods {.tabset}

Exact database and pathway IDs define recurrence. Representatives retain the method calls of their own terms; All terms includes every selected term. Opposite effect signs remain separate. This is descriptive recurrence, with no combined p-value.

```{r fcs-recurrence, results='asis'}
if(has_multi) {
 for(view in c("Representatives","All terms")) {
  cat(sprintf("\n## %s\n\n",view))
  x <- fcs_all_mod %>% filter(selected_C %in% TRUE)
  if(view=="Representatives") x <- report_representatives(x)
  x <- x %>% group_by(database,pathway,description,direction) %>% summarise(
    Methods=paste(sort(unique(toupper(module))),collapse=", "),
    `N methods`=n_distinct(module), Rankings=paste(sort(unique(paste(toupper(module),ranking))),collapse=", "),.groups="drop") %>%
    arrange(desc(`N methods`),database,pathway,direction)
  report_emit(report_table(x))
  write_tsv(x,file.path("compare_results",paste0("fcs_recurrence_",if(view=="Representatives")"representatives" else "all_terms",".tsv")))
 }
}
```

# Interesting Genes {.tabset .tabset-fade}

Rows are selected by any active source-specific call or candidate annotation, then ordered
by CAAS gene p ascending and method count descending. This is a display order, not a
combined score or significance test. Every retained row is available through paging,
column search/order, and CSV/Excel export.

Empirical nominal and BH-adjusted evidence is shown together. CAAS uses its calibrated empirical p-value; direction-specific gene tests retain their own declared families. Position p.emp is pooled over sides. No score-percentile selection or weighted composite is used. N methods is a descriptive count of CAAS, RER and FADE calls, not a combined significance test. Pathway and network memberships are annotations.

```{r interesting_shared_helpers}
# Shared by both Interesting Genes AND Interesting Positions below, defined
# unconditionally (not gated on has_fcs_stats_cmp/has_position_scores_cmp)
# because either table's own gate can be TRUE independently of the other's,
# and build_interesting_positions() below calls these same helpers. Gating
# them behind only one of the two flags would leave them undefined whenever
# that flag was FALSE but the other (needing them) was TRUE.

# Dependency-free HTML escaping (avoids requiring htmltools be attached) and
# a collapsible-<details> renderer for semicolon-joined multi-term cells --
# any kable() call including a column built by .collapsible_list() MUST be
# passed escape = FALSE, or the markup renders as literal text.
.html_escape <- function(x) {
  x <- gsub("&", "&amp;", x, fixed = TRUE)
  x <- gsub("<", "&lt;",  x, fixed = TRUE)
  gsub(">", "&gt;", x, fixed = TRUE)
}
.collapsible_list <- function(joined, sep = "; ") {
  vapply(joined, function(x) {
    if (is.na(x) || !nzchar(x)) return("")
    items <- strsplit(x, sep, fixed = TRUE)[[1]]
    summary_txt <- if (length(items) == 1) .html_escape(stringr::str_trunc(items[1], 40)) else sprintf("%d terms", length(items))
    sprintf("<details><summary>%s</summary>%s</details>",
            summary_txt,
            paste(sprintf("<div>%s</div>", .html_escape(items)), collapse = ""))
  }, character(1), USE.NAMES = FALSE)
}

.collapsible_hypotheses <- function(joined) {
  vapply(joined, function(x) {
    if (is.na(x) || !nzchar(x)) return("")
    items <- unlist(strsplit(as.character(x), "[,;]\\s*"))
    items <- items[nzchar(items)]
    if (length(items) == 0) return("")
    summary_txt <- if (length(items) == 1) .html_escape(items[1]) else sprintf("%d hypotheses", length(items))
    sprintf("<details><summary>%s</summary>%s</details>",
            summary_txt,
            paste(sprintf("<div>%s</div>", .html_escape(items)), collapse = ""))
  }, character(1), USE.NAMES = FALSE)
}

# Per-gene FCS evidence per module: the number of distinct groups of overlapping selected/formal sets
# (cluster_id) whose leading edge holds the gene, capped at .fcs_weight_cap (n_clusters_*, the weight
# in the composite), and -log10 of the smallest q.perm among those sets (evidence_score_*), alongside
# the term-description text. They surface in Interesting Genes/Positions below, distinct from the
# plain CAAS_FCS_sig/RER_FCS_sig boolean (which only says "belongs to >= 1 significant set").
.fcs_terms_for <- function(rk_set) {
  empty <- tibble::tibble(gene=character(),caas_fcs_terms=character(),rer_fcs_terms=character(),caas_fcs_terms_all=character(),rer_fcs_terms_all=character(),
    n_clusters_caas=integer(),n_clusters_rer=integer(),caas_fcs_BH=integer(),rer_fcs_BH=integer(),
    caas_fcs_C=integer(),rer_fcs_C=integer(),min_q_caas=numeric(),min_q_rer=numeric())
  if(!has_le || !has_multi) return(empty)
  res <- le %>% select(module,ranking,database,pathway,gene) %>% distinct() %>%
    filter((module=="rer" & ranking=="global") | (module!="rer" & ranking %in% rk_set)) %>%
    mutate(direction=tolower(ranking)) %>%
    inner_join(fcs_sig_terms,by=c("module","direction","database","pathway"))
  per_module <- function(m) {
    z <- res %>% filter(module==m)
    z$label <- paste0(report_db_abbrev(z$database),":",z$pathway," — ",z$description)
    reps <- fcs_sig_terms %>% filter(module==m,is_representative %in% TRUE) %>%
      transmute(ranking=direction,cluster_id,representative_label=paste0(report_db_abbrev(database),":",pathway," — ",description))
    z <- left_join(z,reps,by=c("ranking","cluster_id"))
    z$representative_label <- coalesce(z$representative_label,z$label)
    z$group_key <- ifelse(is.na(z$cluster_id),paste(z$ranking,z$database,z$pathway),paste(z$ranking,z$cluster_id))
    # Summarize every group actually supporting the gene. Do not discard genes found
    # only in a nonrepresentative leading edge.
    grouped <- z %>% group_by(gene,group_key) %>% summarise(
      label=paste(sort(unique(representative_label)),collapse=" | "),.groups="drop") %>%
      group_by(gene) %>% summarise(grouped_terms=paste(label,collapse="; "),.groups="drop")
    out <- z %>% group_by(gene) %>% summarise(
      terms=paste(sort(unique(label)),collapse="; "),
      groups=n_distinct(group_key),BH=sum(fcs_formal_sig),C=sum(fcs_selected_C),
      min_q=if(any(is.finite(q.perm)))min(q.perm[is.finite(q.perm)]) else NA_real_,.groups="drop")
    out <- left_join(out,grouped,by="gene")
    names(out) <- c("gene",paste0(m,"_fcs_terms_all"),paste0("n_clusters_",m),paste0(m,"_fcs_BH"),paste0(m,"_fcs_C"),paste0("min_q_",m),paste0(m,"_fcs_terms"))
    out
  }
  full_join(per_module("caas"),per_module("rer"),by="gene")
}

.gene_evidence_summary <- function(df, ...) {
 df$`N methods` <- as.integer(df$`CAAS nominal`) + as.integer(df$RER_dir) + as.integer(df$FADE_dir)
 df
}
.position_evidence_summary <- function(df, ...) {
 df$`N methods` <- rowSums(cbind(df$`CAAS nominal` %in% TRUE,df$FADE_overlap %in% TRUE))
 df
}

# Banded table renderer: renders interactive tables styled into four functional color bands:
# Metadata (Charcoal #4A5568), Weighted (Blue #2B6CB0), Descriptive (Amber #C05621), Results (Green #2F855A).
render_banded_table <- function(res_obj, height = NULL) {
  if (is.null(res_obj) || !is.list(res_obj) || is.null(res_obj$data) || nrow(res_obj$data) == 0) return(NULL)
  df <- res_obj$data
  meta_cols <- intersect(res_obj$meta_cols, names(df))
  pond_cols <- intersect(res_obj$pond_cols, names(df))
  desc_cols <- intersect(res_obj$desc_cols, names(df))
  res_cols  <- intersect(res_obj$res_cols,  names(df))

  ordered_cols <- c(meta_cols, pond_cols, desc_cols, res_cols)
  df <- df[, ordered_cols, drop = FALSE]
  report_table(df)
}

.ami_desc_for <- function(dir_filter) {
  if (!has_ami || !exists("ami_disp") || is.null(ami_disp) || nrow(ami_disp) == 0) {
    return(tibble::tibble(gene = character(), caas_ami_desc = character(), rer_ami_desc = character(), fade_ami_desc = character()))
  }
  .ami_gene_col <- if ("all_genes" %in% names(ami_disp)) "all_genes" else if ("genes" %in% names(ami_disp)) "genes" else NULL
  if (is.null(.ami_gene_col) || !"term" %in% names(ami_disp)) {
    return(tibble::tibble(gene = character(), caas_ami_desc = character(), rer_ami_desc = character(), fade_ami_desc = character()))
  }
  
  d <- ami_disp
  if ("direction" %in% names(d) && !is.null(dir_filter)) {
    d <- d %>% dplyr::filter((.tool=="RER" & direction=="Global") | (.tool!="RER" & direction %in% dir_filter))
  }
  if ("domino_p_adj" %in% names(d)) {
    d <- d %>% dplyr::filter(!is.na(domino_p_adj), domino_p_adj <= (params$domino_module_thr %||% 0.05))
  }
  if (nrow(d) == 0) {
    return(tibble::tibble(gene = character(), caas_ami_desc = character(), rer_ami_desc = character(), fade_ami_desc = character()))
  }
  
  d_unnest <- d %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      tool = if (".tool" %in% names(.)) .tool else .ami_tool_classifier(gene_list),
      gene = strsplit(.data[[.ami_gene_col]], ",\\s*"),
      hit_label = sprintf("%s (%s: %s)", term, direction, gene_list)
    ) %>%
    tidyr::unnest(gene) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(gene = trimws(gene))
  
  caas <- d_unnest %>% dplyr::filter(tool == "CAAS") %>%
    dplyr::group_by(gene) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(caas_ami_desc = paste(unique(hit_label), collapse = "; "), .groups = "drop")
  
  rer <- d_unnest %>% dplyr::filter(tool == "RER") %>%
    dplyr::group_by(gene) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(rer_ami_desc = paste(unique(hit_label), collapse = "; "), .groups = "drop")
  
  fade <- d_unnest %>% dplyr::filter(tool == "FADE") %>%
    dplyr::group_by(gene) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(fade_ami_desc = paste(unique(hit_label), collapse = "; "), .groups = "drop")
  
  caas %>%
    dplyr::full_join(rer, by = "gene") %>%
    dplyr::full_join(fade, by = "gene")
}

.position_emp_flags <- function(base, dir_key) {
 base$gene <- sub("\\.[0-9]+$","",trimws(base$Gene))
 base$`CAAS p` <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(evidence_column(base,"p.emp")))
 base$`CAAS BH` <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(evidence_column(base,"p.adj_bh")))
 base$`CAAS nominal` <- if("caas_nominal" %in% names(base))base$caas_nominal else ifelse(is.finite(base$`CAAS p`),base$`CAAS p`<.nominal_cmp,NA)
 base$`CAAS adjusted` <- if("caas_adjusted" %in% names(base))base$caas_adjusted else ifelse(is.finite(base$`CAAS BH`),base$`CAAS BH`<.fdr_cmp,NA)
 base
}

.gcol <- function(df, col) if (col %in% names(df)) df[[col]] else rep(NA, nrow(df))
```

```{r interesting_genes_prep, include=FALSE}
build_interesting_genes <- function(direction) {
  rk <- tolower(direction); sf <- if(rk=="global")"" else paste0("_",rk)
  g <- gene_attr_df
  base <- tibble::tibble(gene=g$gene,
    `CAAS p`=as.numeric(evidence_column(g,paste0("caas_p.gen",sf))),
    `CAAS BH`=as.numeric(evidence_column(g,paste0("caas_p.gen.adj",sf))),
    `CAAS nominal`=as.logical(evidence_column(g,paste0("caas_nominal",sf),NA)),
    `CAAS adjusted`=as.logical(evidence_column(g,paste0("caas_adjusted",sf),NA)),
    `RER p`=as.numeric(evidence_column(g,"rer_p.emp")),`RER BH`=as.numeric(evidence_column(g,"rer_p.adj")),
    `RER rho`=as.numeric(evidence_column(g,"rer_rho")),
    `RER nominal`=as.logical(evidence_column(g,"rer_significant",NA)),
    `FADE call`=as.logical(evidence_column(g,paste0("flag_fade",sf),NA)))
  bf_top <- as.numeric(evidence_column(g,"fade_max_bf_top")); bf_bot <- as.numeric(evidence_column(g,"fade_max_bf_bottom"))
  base$`FADE BF` <- if(rk=="top")bf_top else if(rk=="bottom")bf_bot else pmax(bf_top,bf_bot,na.rm=TRUE)
  base$`FADE BF`[!is.finite(base$`FADE BF`)] <- NA_real_
  base$`RER adjusted` <- as.logical(evidence_column(g,"rer_significant_fdr",NA))
  # Outer joins retain FCS-only and AMI-only candidates, including RER global
  # contributors in each view, without mapping their signs onto CAAS sides.
  out <- full_join(base,.fcs_terms_for(rk),by="gene") %>% full_join(.ami_desc_for(direction),by="gene")
  for(n in c("caas_fcs_terms","rer_fcs_terms","caas_ami_desc","rer_ami_desc","fade_ami_desc")) {
    if(!n %in% names(out))out[[n]] <- NA_character_
  }
  annotation_hit <- Reduce(`|`,lapply(out[c("caas_fcs_terms","rer_fcs_terms","caas_ami_desc","rer_ami_desc","fade_ami_desc")],function(x)!is.na(x)&nzchar(x)))
  direct_hit <- Reduce(`|`,lapply(out[c("CAAS nominal","CAAS adjusted","RER nominal","RER adjusted","FADE call")],function(x)x %in% TRUE))
  out$`N methods` <- rowSums(cbind(out$`CAAS nominal` %in% TRUE,out$`RER nominal` %in% TRUE,out$`FADE call` %in% TRUE))
  out$`Methods with evidence` <- rowSums(cbind(is.finite(out$`CAAS p`),is.finite(out$`RER p`),!is.na(out$`FADE call`)))
  out <- out[direct_hit | annotation_hit,,drop=FALSE] %>% arrange(`CAAS p`,desc(`N methods`),gene)
  out <- out %>% rename(Gene=gene,`CAAS FCS terms`=caas_fcs_terms,`RER FCS terms`=rer_fcs_terms,
    `CAAS FCS all terms`=caas_fcs_terms_all,`RER FCS all terms`=rer_fcs_terms_all,
    `CAAS AMI descriptions`=caas_ami_desc,`RER AMI descriptions`=rer_ami_desc,`FADE AMI descriptions`=fade_ami_desc)
  dir.create("compare_results",showWarnings=FALSE)
  write_tsv(out,file.path("compare_results",paste0("interesting_genes_",rk,".tsv")))
  if(!nrow(out)) return(NULL)
  meta_cols <- "Gene"
  pond_cols <- c("CAAS p","CAAS BH","CAAS nominal","CAAS adjusted","RER p","RER BH","RER rho","RER nominal","RER adjusted","FADE BF","FADE call")
  res_cols <- c("N methods","Methods with evidence")
  desc_cols <- setdiff(names(out),c(meta_cols,pond_cols,res_cols))
  list(data=out,meta_cols=meta_cols,pond_cols=pond_cols,desc_cols=desc_cols,res_cols=res_cols)
}
```

# Interesting Positions {.tabset .tabset-fade}

Positions are ordered by pooled CAAS positional p ascending and CAAS score descending.
The same pooled CAAS p/BH pair is displayed once; FADE overlap is matched to Top/Bottom
sites in those views and to the union of both measured sides globally. FADE positions use the upstream CAAS zero-based alignment coordinates. FCS columns here annotate the gene leading edge; they do not establish position-level pathway evidence. FUBAR displays positive, neutral and purifying.

Empirical nominal and BH-adjusted evidence is shown together. CAAS uses its calibrated empirical p-value; direction-specific gene tests retain their own declared families. Position p.emp is pooled over sides. No score-percentile selection or weighted composite is used. N methods is a descriptive count of CAAS, RER and FADE calls, not a combined significance test. Pathway and network memberships are annotations.

```{r interesting_positions_prep, eval=has_position_scores_cmp}
build_interesting_positions <- function(direction) {
  rk_set    <- switch(direction, Top = "top", Bottom = "bottom", "global")
  side_vals <- switch(direction, Top = "top", Bottom = "bottom", NULL)

  base <- position_scores_cmp_df
  if (direction == "Top") {
    base <- base %>% dplyr::filter(side == "top")
  } else if (direction == "Bottom") {
    base <- base %>% dplyr::filter(side == "bottom")
  } else {
    base <- base %>%
      dplyr::arrange(
        dplyr::desc(CAAS_score),
        dplyr::desc(if ("n_hypotheses" %in% names(.)) n_hypotheses else 0)
      ) %>%
      dplyr::distinct(Gene, Position, .keep_all = TRUE)
  }
  if (nrow(base) == 0) return(NULL)

  # Harmonize hypothesis column names from position_scores.tsv / upstream discovery
  if (!"participating_hypotheses" %in% names(base) && "supporting_hypotheses" %in% names(base)) {
    base$participating_hypotheses <- base$supporting_hypotheses
  }
  if (!"supporting_hypotheses" %in% names(base) && "participating_hypotheses" %in% names(base)) {
    base$supporting_hypotheses <- base$participating_hypotheses
  }
  if (!"n_hypotheses" %in% names(base) && "supporting_hypotheses" %in% names(base)) {
    base$n_hypotheses <- vapply(strsplit(as.character(base$supporting_hypotheses), "[,;]\\s*"), function(x) length(x[nzchar(x)]), integer(1))
  }

  base <- .position_emp_flags(base, tolower(direction))
  base <- base %>% dplyr::distinct(gene, Position, .keep_all = TRUE)

  # An existing empty selected-sites file means evaluated with no hits;
  # an absent side remains unknown. Global is the union of available sides.
  fade_df <- switch(direction,
    Top = fade_sites_top_cmp_df, Bottom = fade_sites_bottom_cmp_df,
    dplyr::bind_rows(fade_sites_top_cmp_df, fade_sites_bottom_cmp_df))
  has_fade_pos <- switch(direction,Top=has_fade_sites_top_cmp,
    Bottom=has_fade_sites_bottom_cmp,has_fade_sites_top_cmp || has_fade_sites_bottom_cmp)
  fade_complete <- switch(direction,Top=has_fade_sites_top_cmp,
    Bottom=has_fade_sites_bottom_cmp,has_fade_sites_top_cmp && has_fade_sites_bottom_cmp)
  fade_hits <- if(!is.null(fade_df) && nrow(fade_df)>0)
    paste(base$gene,base$Position) %in% paste(fade_df$gene,fade_df$Position) else rep(FALSE,nrow(base))
  base$FADE_overlap <- ifelse(fade_hits,TRUE,if(fade_complete)FALSE else NA)
  if(!is.null(fade_df) && nrow(fade_df)) {
    fd <- fade_df %>% group_by(gene,Position) %>% summarise(`FADE site BF`=max(max_bf),`FADE target AA`=paste(sort(unique(target_aa)),collapse=", "),.groups="drop")
    base <- left_join(base,fd,by=c("gene","Position"))
  } else {base$`FADE site BF`<-NA_real_;base$`FADE target AA`<-NA_character_}
  ft <- .fcs_terms_for(rk_set)
  base <- left_join(base,ft %>% select(gene,caas_fcs_terms,rer_fcs_terms,caas_fcs_terms_all,rer_fcs_terms_all),by="gene")
  base$`Gene CAAS FCS terms` <- base$caas_fcs_terms
  base$`Gene RER FCS terms` <- base$rer_fcs_terms
  base$`Gene CAAS FCS all terms` <- base$caas_fcs_terms_all
  base$`Gene RER FCS all terms` <- base$rer_fcs_terms_all

  # Biochemical groupings of the derived side (biochem_groupings and is_biochem); the columns are not shown when
  # position_scores.tsv does not carry them.
  has_biochem_pos <- "biochem_groupings" %in% names(base)
  if (!has_biochem_pos) {
    base$biochem_groupings <- NA_character_
    base$is_biochem <- FALSE
  }
  base$is_biochem <- dplyr::coalesce(as.logical(base$is_biochem), FALSE)
  base$biochem_groupings <- dplyr::coalesce(as.character(base$biochem_groupings), "")

  # External characterization: PrimateAI-3D
  has_pai3d_pos <- FALSE
  if (has_vep_primateai_cmp && !is.null(vep_primateai_cmp_df) && nrow(vep_primateai_cmp_df) > 0) {
    .pai <- vep_primateai_cmp_df
    .pred_col <- intersect(c("prediction"), names(.pai))[1]
    if (!is.na(.pred_col)) {
      .pai_pos <- .pai %>%
        dplyr::mutate(.patho = grepl("pathogenic", .data[[.pred_col]], ignore.case = TRUE)) %>%
        dplyr::group_by(Gene, Position) %>% dplyr::summarise(.patho = any(.patho), .groups = "drop")
      .m <- .pai_pos[match(paste(base$gene, base$Position), paste(.pai_pos$Gene, .pai_pos$Position)), ]
      base$PAI3D_pathogenic <- dplyr::case_when(is.na(.m$.patho) ~ "missing", .m$.patho ~ "pathogenic", TRUE ~ "benign")
      has_pai3d_pos <- any(base$PAI3D_pathogenic != "missing")
    }
  }
  if (!has_pai3d_pos) base$PAI3D_pathogenic <- rep("missing", nrow(base))

  # External characterization: COSMIC
  has_cosmic_pos <- FALSE
  if (has_vep_cosmic_cmp && !is.null(vep_cosmic_cmp_df) && nrow(vep_cosmic_cmp_df) > 0) {
    .cosmic <- vep_cosmic_cmp_df
    .cosmic_hit <- paste(base$gene, base$Position) %in% paste(.cosmic$Gene, .cosmic$Position)
    .checkable <- if (has_pai3d_pos) base$PAI3D_pathogenic != "missing" else rep(TRUE, nrow(base))
    base$COSMIC <- dplyr::case_when(.cosmic_hit ~ "hit", .checkable ~ "no_hit", TRUE ~ "missing")
    has_cosmic_pos <- any(base$COSMIC != "missing")
  }
  if (!has_cosmic_pos) base$COSMIC <- rep("missing", nrow(base))

  # External characterization: Ensembl VEP consequence
  has_vep_ensembl_pos <- FALSE
  if (has_vep_ensembl_cmp && !is.null(vep_ensembl_cmp_df) && nrow(vep_ensembl_cmp_df) > 0 && "Consequence" %in% names(vep_ensembl_cmp_df)) {
    .vep_ens <- vep_ensembl_cmp_df
    # One consequence per position and side (MANE Select, else canonical, else the most severe over all transcripts).
    # A table without a side column is matched by Gene and Position only.
    .vep_has_side <- "side" %in% names(.vep_ens) && "side" %in% names(base)
    if (!.vep_has_side) message("Ensembl VEP table has no side column: positions matched by Gene and Position only.")
    .vep_by <- if (.vep_has_side) c("Gene", "Position", "side") else c("Gene", "Position")
    .vep_ens_pos <- collapse_vep_consequence(.vep_ens, by = .vep_by)
    .vep_ens_pos$.conseq <- gsub(",", "; ", .vep_ens_pos$Consequence, fixed = TRUE)
    .key_ens  <- do.call(paste, c(unname(as.list(.vep_ens_pos[.vep_by])), sep = "\r"))
    .key_base <- if (.vep_has_side) paste(base$gene, base$Position, base$side, sep = "\r") else paste(base$gene, base$Position, sep = "\r")
    .me <- .vep_ens_pos[match(.key_base, .key_ens), ]
    base$VEP_consequence <- dplyr::coalesce(dplyr::na_if(.me$.conseq, ""), "missing")
    has_vep_ensembl_pos <- any(base$VEP_consequence != "missing")
  }
  if (!has_vep_ensembl_pos) base$VEP_consequence <- rep("missing", nrow(base))

  # Position characterization GMTs: Pfam, UCR, variability, FUBAR
  has_pfam_pos  <- FALSE
  has_ucr_pos   <- FALSE
  has_var_pos   <- FALSE
  has_fubar_pos <- FALSE
  if (has_position_char_cmp && !is.null(position_char_cmp_df) && nrow(position_char_cmp_df) > 0) {
    base <- base %>%
      dplyr::left_join(
        position_char_cmp_df %>%
          dplyr::distinct(Gene, Position, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
          dplyr::select(gene = Gene, Position, dplyr::any_of(c(
            "pfam_domain", "pfam_clan", "ucr_region", "position_variability", "fubar_selection"))),
        by = c("gene", "Position"))
  }
  for (.col in c("pfam_domain", "pfam_clan", "ucr_region", "position_variability", "fubar_selection")) {
    if (!.col %in% names(base)) base[[.col]] <- NA
  }
  has_pfam_pos  <- any(!is.na(base$pfam_domain) & nzchar(as.character(base$pfam_domain))) ||
                   any(!is.na(base$pfam_clan)   & nzchar(as.character(base$pfam_clan)))
  has_ucr_pos   <- any(!is.na(base$ucr_region)  & nzchar(as.character(base$ucr_region)))
  has_var_pos   <- any(!is.na(base$position_variability) & nzchar(as.character(base$position_variability)))
  has_fubar_pos <- any(!is.na(base$fubar_selection) & nzchar(as.character(base$fubar_selection)))

  # Empirical p-values
  has_pemp <- "p.emp" %in% names(base) && any(!is.na(base$p.emp))
  has_padj <- "p.adj_bh" %in% names(base) && any(!is.na(base$p.adj_bh))

  # Hypotheses
  has_hypotheses <- ("supporting_hypotheses" %in% names(base)) && any(!is.na(base$supporting_hypotheses) & nzchar(as.character(base$supporting_hypotheses)))

  # Format residues
  has_top_res <- "top_species_residues" %in% names(base) && any(!is.na(base$top_species_residues) & nzchar(as.character(base$top_species_residues)))
  has_bot_res <- "bottom_species_residues" %in% names(base) && any(!is.na(base$bottom_species_residues) & nzchar(as.character(base$bottom_species_residues)))
  has_pairs   <- "n_conserved_pairs" %in% names(base) && any(!is.na(base$n_conserved_pairs) & nzchar(as.character(base$n_conserved_pairs)))

  all_positions <- base %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      dplyr::across(c(`CAAS nominal`, `CAAS adjusted`, FADE_overlap), identity)
    )

  # Position composite: strictly CAAS + FADE site overlap. Zero gene-level weights!
  out <- all_positions %>%
    .position_evidence_summary(has_fade = has_fade_pos)

  # Filter to positions meeting at least one active criterion
  out <- out %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      `CAAS nominal` | `CAAS adjusted` | FADE_overlap | is_biochem |
      (if (has_cosmic_pos) COSMIC == "hit" else FALSE) |
      (if (has_pai3d_pos) PAI3D_pathogenic == "pathogenic" else FALSE)
    )
  dir.create("compare_results",showWarnings=FALSE)
  write_tsv(out %>% arrange(`CAAS p`,desc(CAAS_score)) %>% select(-any_of(c("p.emp","p.adj_bh"))),
    file.path("compare_results",paste0("interesting_positions_",tolower(direction),".tsv")))
  if(!nrow(out)) return(NULL)

  out <- out %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      `N Hypotheses`        = if ("n_hypotheses" %in% names(.)) as.integer(n_hypotheses) else NA_integer_,
      `Hypotheses`          = if ("supporting_hypotheses" %in% names(.)) supporting_hypotheses else "",
      `CAAS`                = if ("caas" %in% names(.)) caas else NA_character_,
      `Top species residues`    = {
        .ts <- if ("top_species_residues" %in% names(.)) top_species_residues else NA_character_
        .cs <- if ("caas" %in% names(.)) caas else NA_character_
        dplyr::if_else(is.na(.ts) | !nzchar(.ts) | .ts == "NA",
                       dplyr::if_else(grepl("/", .cs), sub("/.*", "", .cs), .cs),
                       .ts)
      },
      `Conserved pairs` = if ("n_conserved_pairs" %in% names(.)) dplyr::na_if(as.character(n_conserved_pairs), "") else NA_character_,
      `Bottom species residues` = {
        .bs <- if ("bottom_species_residues" %in% names(.)) bottom_species_residues else NA_character_
        .cs <- if ("caas" %in% names(.)) caas else NA_character_
        dplyr::if_else(is.na(.bs) | !nzchar(.bs) | .bs == "NA",
                       dplyr::if_else(grepl("/", .cs), sub(".*/", "", .cs), NA_character_),
                       .bs)
      }
    )

  # Define the 4 tramos dynamically
  meta_cols <- c("Gene", "Position", "CAAS")
  if (has_top_res) meta_cols <- c(meta_cols, "Top species residues")
  if (has_bot_res) meta_cols <- c(meta_cols, "Bottom species residues")
  if (has_pairs)   meta_cols <- c(meta_cols, "Conserved pairs")
  if (has_hypotheses) meta_cols <- c(meta_cols, "N Hypotheses", "Hypotheses")
  meta_cols <- c(meta_cols, "CAAS Score")

  pond_cols <- c("CAAS p","CAAS BH","CAAS nominal","CAAS adjusted")
  if (has_fade_pos) pond_cols <- c(pond_cols, "FADE_overlap", "FADE site BF", "FADE target AA")

  desc_cols <- if (has_biochem_pos) c("biochem_groupings", "is_biochem") else c()
  desc_cols <- c(desc_cols,"Gene CAAS FCS terms","Gene RER FCS terms","Gene CAAS FCS all terms","Gene RER FCS all terms")
  # CAAS p and CAAS BH above are the canonical pooled positional pair.
  if (has_cosmic_pos)      desc_cols <- c(desc_cols, "COSMIC")
  if (has_pai3d_pos)       desc_cols <- c(desc_cols, "PAI3D_pathogenic")
  if (has_vep_ensembl_pos) desc_cols <- c(desc_cols, "VEP_consequence")
  if (has_pfam_pos) {
    if (any(!is.na(base$pfam_domain) & nzchar(as.character(base$pfam_domain)))) desc_cols <- c(desc_cols, "Pfam domain")
    if (any(!is.na(base$pfam_clan) & nzchar(as.character(base$pfam_clan)))) desc_cols <- c(desc_cols, "Pfam clan")
  }
  if (has_ucr_pos)   desc_cols <- c(desc_cols, "UCR region")
  if (has_var_pos)   desc_cols <- c(desc_cols, "Position variability")
  if (has_fubar_pos) desc_cols <- c(desc_cols, "FUBAR selection")

  res_cols <- "N methods"

  out$gene <- NULL
  if ("CAAS_score" %in% names(out)) out$`CAAS Score` <- out$CAAS_score
  if ("pfam_domain" %in% names(out)) out$`Pfam domain` <- out$pfam_domain
  if ("pfam_clan" %in% names(out)) out$`Pfam clan` <- out$pfam_clan
  if ("ucr_region" %in% names(out)) out$`UCR region` <- out$ucr_region
  if ("position_variability" %in% names(out)) out$`Position variability` <- out$position_variability
  # fubar_selection is an all-NA logical column when no FUBAR table was supplied; recode needs character
  if ("fubar_selection" %in% names(out)) out$`FUBAR selection` <- dplyr::recode(as.character(out$fubar_selection),negative="purifying",pervasive="purifying")

  out <- out %>%
    dplyr::arrange(`CAAS p`, dplyr::desc(`CAAS Score`)) %>%
    dplyr::select(dplyr::all_of(c(meta_cols, pond_cols, desc_cols, res_cols)))

  list(
    data      = out,
    meta_cols = meta_cols,
    pond_cols = pond_cols,
    desc_cols = desc_cols,
    res_cols  = res_cols
  )
}
```

```{r interesting_positions_tabs, eval=has_position_scores_cmp, results='asis'}
for (dr in c("Global", "Top", "Bottom")) {
  cat(sprintf("\n## %s\n\n", dr))
  res <- build_interesting_positions(dr)
  cat(sprintf("[TSV completo](../compare/compare_results/interesting_positions_%s.tsv)\n\n",tolower(dr)))
  if (is.null(res) || is.null(res$data) || nrow(res$data) == 0) {
    cat("_No positions meet any criterion for this direction._\n\n")
    next
  }
  emit_widget(render_banded_table(res, height = if (nrow(res$data) > 15) "480px" else NULL))
}
```
